title: check.py's lexical code scan skips a comment inside an f-string replacement field
goal: code_comment_lines records a comment inside a multi-line f-string's replacement field as a comment line, as tokenize does, so a citation there is checked. Found by the SP-acysfnxr review (BG-v6bpucd2 gap 1).

run: import os,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import check;n=chr(10);p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"x.py");open(p,"w").write("x = f\"{x # c1"+n+"}\""+n+"# c"+n);got=sorted(k for k,_ in check.code_comment_lines(p));print("comment lines",got,"want [1, 3]");sys.exit(0 if got==[1,3] else 1)
